column1: # Type3arabi seed transliteration rules — human-reviewed prior for EM (docs/03 §4, docs/04 §6).
# Columns (TAB-separated): latin  arabic  weight  pos  dialects  flags  note
#   latin    : 1-4 symbols; uppercase T S D Z H are the emphatic symbols (docs/03 §3); ' is a symbol.
#   arabic   : 0-3 Arabic letters; "ε" = nothing (a short vowel).
#   weight   : seed estimate of P(arabic | latin, pos, dialect). The loader normalizes each group to sum 1.
#   pos      : any combination of I (initial), M (medial), F (final), or * (= IMF).
#   dialects : * or comma list of MSA,LEV,EGY,GLF,IRQ,MAG.
#   flags    : - or comma list of VOWEL, GEM, TANWEEN, ARTICLE.
# Resolution ("most specific wins"): for chunk ℓ at position p in dialect d, use rows whose pos lists p
# explicitly if any exist, else rows with pos *; within those, rows naming d explicitly if any exist, else
# rows with dialect *. Gemination (bb, ll, 77 ...) is generic in the engine (docs/03 §4.3) — not listed here.
